user.title: Connect Zigbee2MQTT
user.description: Installation only connects to the existing catalog. Circuits and groups are added afterwards from Configure. The report extension is optional here and required for active pilot testing. These timings are shared by every circuit. No device commands are sent.

data.report_extension: Use Zigbee2MQTT report extension (see installation guide)

abort.single_instance: Only one Zigbee LED Orchestrator instance is supported. Add circuits and groups from Configure on the existing entry.

choose.title: Configure
choose.description: Add or edit a circuit or group, or change the control mode. Each circuit and group is a device on the integration page: open it to see its diagnostics, use the pencil to rename it or set its area, or delete it from the device menu. Saving reloads the integration. Control turns on again when the catalog is back and does not replay an old ON.

control.title: Control mode
control.description: Control turns on when the Zigbee2MQTT bridge is online and the saved circuits are in the catalog. A missing circuit is reported in Home Assistant and the other circuits keep working. Turning this off keeps control off until you enable it again. An old ON is never replayed.

add_circuit.title: Add circuit
add_circuit.description: Name the virtual light and select one controller with its power channel. This does not add the circuit to a group. Saving reloads the integration. Control turns on again when the catalog is back and does not replay an old ON.

create_group.title: Create group
create_group.description: Name the group and select which added circuits belong to it. A name such as Salon creates the Zigbee2MQTT group and light entity Salon_orchestrator. A circuit already in another group is not listed. Saving reloads the integration. Control turns on again when the catalog is back and does not replay an old ON.

circuit_details.title: Edit circuit {circuit}
circuit_details.description: Change the name, controller or power channel. The light and its diagnostics keep their entity ids and history. A circuit in a group keeps its controller and channel; remove it from the group first. Saving reloads the integration.

group_details.title: Edit group {group}
group_details.description: Change the name or the circuits in the group. A new name renames the Zigbee2MQTT group, which keeps its Zigbee id. A circuit removed from the group leaves it in Zigbee2MQTT and an added one joins it the next time its controller is powered; until then the group is unavailable and its circuits work on their own. No power is switched for this. Saving reloads the integration.

error.control_unavailable: Control is unavailable. Check bridge connectivity, mapping and report-extension diagnostics. Resync after a topology change.
error.topology_stale: The Zigbee2MQTT catalog changed for these circuits. Run resync, then enable control again. Previous ON commands are not replayed.
error.mapping_mismatch: The saved mapping does not match the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Check devices, endpoints and relay channels.
error.runtime_not_running: The integration is not running. Restart Home Assistant, then try again.
error.bridge_unavailable: The MQTT connection or Zigbee2MQTT bridge is offline. Control stays off until the bridge is online.
error.report_extension_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT report extension is not ready. Check report_extension_ready in diagnostics and run resync after loading the extension.
error.devices_missing: None of the configured circuits are in the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Control stays off until one of them returns.
error.invalid_mapping: The configuration or physical mapping is invalid.
error.invalid_name: The virtual entity name must be nonempty and have no surrounding spaces.
error.invalid_group_name: The group name is empty, too long, or contains characters Zigbee2MQTT cannot use.
error.need_two_members: Select at least two circuits for the group.
error.already_mapped: That name, controller, or relay channel is already used.
error.catalog_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT device and group catalog is unavailable.
error.circuit_in_group: This circuit belongs to a group. Remove it from the group before changing its controller or channel.
error.group_rename_failed: Zigbee2MQTT did not confirm the rename. Check that the bridge is online and try again.

abort.catalog_unavailable: The Zigbee2MQTT device and group catalog is unavailable.
abort.no_free_circuit: Every discovered controller or relay channel is already mapped.
abort.need_two_circuits: Add at least two circuits that are not already in a group.

pause.name: Pause control
pause.description: Disable control and set every light's desired state to off without publishing.

resume.name: Resume control
resume.description: Restore the mode that was active before the pause. Previous commands are not replayed.

resync.name: Resync catalog
resync.description: Discard observations and re-read the Zigbee2MQTT catalog. Control must be enabled again afterwards.

circuit_in_group.message: This circuit belongs to group {group}. Remove it from the group or delete the group first.

runtime_not_running.message: The integration is not running. Restart Home Assistant, then try again.

group_remove_failed.message: Zigbee2MQTT did not remove the group, so it is kept: {error}. Power the group's circuits so every controller can answer, then try again.

group_remove_unknown.message: Zigbee2MQTT did not answer in time. The group is kept here and left alone. Try deleting it again in a moment.
